frequency_question: What proportion of major proposed transport/industrial subsidy schemes achieve final formal notification and implementation within one year of proposal?
membership_rule: Includes: formal policy frameworks or financing schemes targeting commercial vehicle/public transport electrification or industrial upgrading announced by national ministries. Excludes: minor amendments to existing schemes, sub-national state-level policies, and non-financial promotional declarations.

validity_reason: Policy mechanisms and bureaucratic approval speeds for national industrial subsidies remain stable across medium-term planning cycles.
